LightningComponentBundle.description: Every async job that ran, runs or will run for this record, with requeue for failed steps.

property.name: daysBack
property.label: Default range in days
property.description: Range selected when the card opens; the viewer can switch to 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days or all time. Blank means 7.

property.name: chainsPerPage
property.label: Sequences per page
property.description: Chains shown per page. 0 fits as many collapsed chains as the height allows, so a page never scrolls until you open a chain.

property.name: maxHeight
property.label: Max height in pixels
property.description: The list scrolls inside the card above this height. 0 lets the card grow.

property.name: liveRefreshOff
property.label: Turn off live refresh
property.description: By default the card polls while a chain is in flight: every 3 seconds while a job runs, every 10 seconds while queued, never when idle. Turn on to load once and refresh by hand only.

property.name: followNewRuns
property.label: Follow new runs
property.description: When on, a chain that enters in flight opens by itself and the others collapse, for a card left open on a screen. Off: the new chain is only flagged. The viewer can switch it for the session.
